widgets.title: First launches, by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first name=app_opened platform!=sonos platform!=alexa | timechart count by platform

widgets.title: Seconds listened (app)
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name IN (read_paused, read_stopped) seconds>=0 platform!=sonos platform!=alexa | timechart sum(seconds) as seconds

widgets.title: First-launch funnel (sessions), by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first platform!=sonos platform!=alexa | stats count(eval(name="intro_ended")) as onb, count(eval(name="book_opened")) as bo, count(eval(name="read_started")) as rs, count(eval(name="book_listened")) as l30 by session, platform | eval onboarded=if(onb>0,1,0), book_opened=if(bo>0,1,0), read_started=if(rs>0,1,0), listened_30s=if(l30>0,1,0) | stats count as sessions, sum(onboarded) as onboarded, sum(book_opened) as book_opened, sum(read_started) as read_started, sum(listened_30s) as listened_30s by platform

widgets.title: Where first sessions stopped (last screen and event)
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first platform!=sonos platform!=alexa | eventstats max(seq) as lastseq by session | where seq == lastseq | stats count by screen, name

widgets.title: Fallbacks, by reason
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=fallback | timechart count by detail
